data.exact_reserve_text:
The estimate for claims at the beginning of the year as compared with net payments and provisions at the end of the year in respect of prior years' claims are as follows:

Marine, aviation and transport 15.8 22.4
Fire and other damage to property 51.7 25.9
Third party liability (8.0) (8.8)
Miscellaneous (3.1) (2.2)

Favourable movement in technical provisions 56.4 37.3
The movement in estimate of the prior year is driven mainly by favourable loss experience and incurred claims forms a 10% (2020: 7%) component of the 2021 loss ratio of 46% (2020: 53%).
data.standardized_narrative: The gross prior-year reserve movement shows a small net strengthening of approximately GBP 4.0m (about 0.48% of opening gross claims outstanding), driven by adverse movement in some older underwriting years partially offset by favourable development in others. The reporting notes describe the prior year estimate movement as driven mainly by favourable loss experience on a net basis, but the gross claims development triangle (excluding the aggregated "2016 & prior" column) yields a modest net strengthening concentrated in the older years (2017-2019).
raw_causal_phrases: The movement in estimate of the prior year is driven mainly by favourable loss experience and incurred claims forms a 10% (2020: 7%) component of the 2021 loss ratio of 46% (2020: 53%).

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from the Balance Sheet (liabilities) 2020 comparative column. Prior year development derived from the GROSS claims development tables (triangle) by excluding the aggregated '2016 & prior' column and excluding the two most recent underwriting years (2020, 2021). Note 6 ("Prior years' claims estimate") reports a net favourable movement (GBP 56.4m) which is net of reinsurance; the gross triangle yields a modest gross strengthening of GBP 4.0m. LOB movements shown above are taken from the prior years' claims estimate table (note 6) which appears to be NET of reinsurance; these are included because per-LOB gross movements are not provided. Where net vs gross ambiguity exists, confidence scores are reduced accordingly.
